description: DESTRUCTIVE: removes the link for good — its page and every printed QR stop working and the slug is freed. Invoices already paid through it are kept. To stop it for a while use qutpay_pause_payment_link. With a LIVE key confirm=true is required, only after the merchant explicitly asked to delete.
name: qutpay_delete_payment_link
title: Delete a payment link (irreversible)
